onboarding-user-highlight.text: Your own highlights: a note to yourself while you read, which you can change later.
onboarding-user-highlight.quote: Your own highlights keep their notes, and you can change a note whenever you like.

onboarding-agent-highlight.text: The agent's highlights are labelled as its own, so you always know who marked what.
onboarding-agent-highlight.quote: The agent can highlight passages too, and its own are labelled as its own.
